thread:
maria_ml: FYI started Parallax LoRA merge into base v2.1.0. Quick smoke shows tokenization mismatch on their legal prompts.
sasha_research: can you paste one failing example?
maria_ml: sure — example below. Their tokenizer splits 'non-disclosure' differently.
```
Input: "Please provide the non-disclosure summary for client X."
Baseline tokens: [Please, provide, the, non, -, disclosure, summary, for, client, X]
Parallax tokens: [Please, provide, the, non-, disclosure, summary, for, client, X]
```
parth_se: ugh — subtle but could shift KV cache alignment. Did you run the int4 quantized run yet?
maria_ml: ran quick int4 on 50 legal prompts. Mean answer similarity vs fp16: 0.93, but legal clause extraction F1 dropped 6% (seen on a handful).
eva_prod: that F1 delta is worrying for the customer. do we have a targeted eval pack for legal domain from Parallax?
lina_qc: we do — sent earlier. I'll re-run with updated tokenizer mapping if you push it.
tony_infra: also saw a runtime warning in the batcher on one node during the merge smoke: "KV cache resize failed: requested 1.5GB > max 1.0GB" — might be the sequence remap.
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:10Z] batcher WARN: KV cache resize failed: requested=1610612736, max=1073741824
```
maria_ml: thanks tony. I think parallax adapter added extra BOS tokens in a few cases. I'll run a token remap script.
sasha_research: suggest adding a quick canary: route 5% traffic to fp16 baseline for legal routes and compare outputs/latency for 24h.
parth_se: here's the remap I used locally:
```
# remap leading subwords
python tools/token_remap.py --map-file parallax_remap.json --input tests/legal_prompts.jsonl --output remapped.jsonl
```
maria_ml: ran remap, re-quantized, re-ran 50 prompt pack. New F1 delta down to 1.2% and tokenization aligned on the sample.
lina_qc: can you upload the fresh eval CSV? I'll run the regression scans and diff report.
maria_ml: uploaded to https://redwood.internal/runs/26351/parallax-remap-quick.csv : avg_latency +3ms, tokens/sec +0.1, legal_F1 -1.2%.
eva_prod: +3ms is fine, F1 delta acceptable to customer if we include notes and fallback plan.
sasha_research: add a fallback policy: if confidence < 0.85 for clause extraction, route to fp16. Also log tokenization mismatches to telemetry.
parth_se: will add policy and telemetry flag. pushing the canary config now.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: canary-parallax-merge -> eng-ml-canary (id: dply-9881)

maria_ml: after canary rollout (5%) we observed 3 regressions out of 2k calls; all tied to edge-case list enumerations. I've flagged for model team.
lina_qc: will add those prompts to the golden set and re-run nightly.
ton... infra: patched batcher kv-resize limit in staging to 2GB for canary nodes; monitoring.
sasha_research: thumbs up — next steps: (1) finish canary 24h, (2) collect telemetry diffs, (3) if regressions <=5 per 10k and no security/legal issues, promote.
maria_ml: assigning owners: maria_ml (merge fixes), parth_se (canary routing), lina_qc (regression pack), tony_infra (kv config). I'll update customer-facing notes.
eva_prod: ping customer success once promote looks good. :white_check_mark:
parth_se: pushed PR with routing + telemetry, ci green.
maria_ml: closing out for now — will post final eval after 24h canary. thanks all :rocket:
